metadata.description: Adversarial corpus for SIM compliance/grammar testing (Phase 3.5)

entries.text: The contract documents specify the required concrete strength.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract documents' — compound noun phrase is legitimate lowercase usage.

entries.text: Submit contract specifications to the Contracting Officer for review.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract specification(s)' — compound noun phrase is legitimate lowercase usage.

entries.text: The subcontract requirements are defined in Division 01.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract exclusion: 'sub' precedes 'contract' — before-text check catches 'subcontract'.

entries.text: Install P & T relief valves on all water heaters.

expected.reason: SYM-and matches & between words. 'P & T' is a standard abbreviation (Pressure & Temperature) — real FP found 5x in clean corpus.

entries.text: The Instrumentation & Control system conforms to ASHRAE standards.

expected.reason: SYM-and has no proper-name exclusion for & in organization names. Real FP from clean corpus.

entries.text: Install head pressure gauges at each pump discharge.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-head has NO compound-term exclusion for 'head pressure'. Simple \bhead\b matches. Real FP (17 in clean corpus).

entries.text: Provide shower head assemblies conforming to the flow rate requirements.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-head has no exclusion for 'shower head'. Will flag despite being standard plumbing terminology.

entries.text: Maintain minimum headroom of 2100 mm in all corridors.

expected.reason: 'headroom' is a single word — \bhead\b won't match inside it because 'r' follows 'head' without a word boundary.

entries.text: Calculate head loss through the piping system per ASHRAE Fundamentals.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-head will match 'head' even though 'head loss' is standard hydraulic engineering terminology. No context exclusion exists.

entries.text: Spray heads must be UL listed and FM approved.

expected.reason: 'heads' (plural) — \bhead\b will NOT match 'heads' because 's' follows without a word boundary.

entries.text: Perform testing per ASTM C150 requirements.

expected.reason: 'per ASTM' — not in the exclusion list. UFS requires 'in accordance with'. This IS a true positive.

entries.text: Apply coating at a rate of 3 liters per square meter.

expected.reason: 'per square' — the exclusion now covers 'square' in addition to 'sq'. This should NOT flag.

entries.text: The flow rate is 5 gallons per minute.

expected.reason: 'per min' is in the exclusion list — this should NOT flag.

entries.text: Concrete strength must reach 4000 psi per the approved mix design.

expected.reason: 'per the' is NOT in the exclusion list. 'per the [noun]' means 'in accordance with' — this IS a valid TERM-per violation.

entries.text: Install one unit per floor in buildings over three stories.

expected.reason: 'per floor' — 'floor' is now in the exclusion list. Valid rate expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: The capacity is 500 watts per channel.

expected.reason: 'per channel' — 'channel' is now in the exclusion list. Valid rate expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: Ventilation rate of 15 CFM per person is required.

expected.reason: 'per person' — 'person' is now in the exclusion list. Valid rate expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: Install expansion joints at intervals per the manufacturer recommendations.

expected.reason: 'per the manufacturer' = 'in accordance with the manufacturer'. This IS a valid TERM-per violation per UFS.

entries.text: Any of the following adhesives may be used for this application.

expected.reason: 'any of the following' is in the exclusion list — should NOT flag.

entries.text: Any one of the listed manufacturers is acceptable.

expected.reason: 'any one of' is in the exclusion list — should NOT flag.

entries.text: Do not use any solvent-based coatings in occupied spaces.

expected.reason: 'any solvent-based' — 'solvent-based' doesn't match exclusion patterns (of the following|one of|other). This WILL flag.

entries.text: Remove any debris from the excavation before placing concrete.

expected.reason: 'any debris' does not match exclusion. Will flag despite 'any' being a normal determiner here.

entries.text: Provide any other submittals required by the referenced standards.

expected.reason: 'any other' IS in the exclusion list — should NOT flag.

entries.text: Use galvanized steel fasteners for all exterior connections.

expected.reason: 'galvanized' is a past participle used as adjective modifying 'steel'. No 'be' auxiliary — should NOT trigger passive voice.

entries.text: The steel is galvanized to ASTM A123 requirements.

expected.reason: 'is galvanized' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'galvanized' is recognized as a state description, not passive voice.

entries.text: The reinforced concrete foundation extends 1200 mm below grade.

expected.reason: 'reinforced' is an adjective modifying 'concrete'. No 'be' verb — should NOT flag.

entries.text: The concrete is reinforced with Grade 60 rebar.

expected.reason: 'is reinforced' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'reinforced' describes a material state, not passive action.

entries.text: The pipe is insulated with 25 mm thick fiberglass.

expected.reason: 'is insulated' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'insulated' describes a material state.

entries.text: The pipe is installed by the Contractor in accessible locations.

expected.reason: 'is installed by' — clear passive voice with agent ('by the Contractor'). 'installed' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Should flag.

entries.text: Preformed joint filler conforms to ASTM D1751.

expected.reason: 'Preformed' is an adjective, not a passive construction. No 'be' verb present.

entries.text: Use tempered glass for all exterior glazing above 600 mm.

expected.reason: 'tempered' is an attributive adjective. No 'be' auxiliary — should NOT flag.

entries.text: The ductwork is connected to the air handling unit.

expected.reason: 'is connected' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'connected' describes a state of the ductwork.

entries.text: Welded connections are preferred for high-pressure systems.

expected.reason: 'are preferred' — passive voice. 'preferred' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Engine should flag.

entries.text: The embedded anchor bolts extend 300 mm into the concrete.

expected.reason: 'embedded' is an attributive adjective modifying 'anchor bolts'. No 'be' verb.

entries.text: The bolts are embedded 300 mm into the concrete foundation.

expected.reason: 'are embedded' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'embedded' describes a physical state of the bolts.

entries.text: Coated rebar is required for all bridge deck applications.

expected.reason: 'is required' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'required' is in the set as an engineering state adjective.

entries.text: The painted surface is inspected visually for defects.

expected.reason: 'is inspected' — passive voice. 'inspected' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Engine should flag. 'painted' is just an adjective.

entries.text: The laminated beam is manufactured off-site and delivered to the project.

expected.reason: 'is manufactured' — passive voice. 'manufactured' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Engine should flag the passive.

entries.text: The Contractor shall submit shop drawings within 30 days.

expected.reason: Clear 'shall' violation. Must be caught.

entries.text: Materials shall conform to ASTM C150 and be stored in a dry location.

expected.reason: 'shall' in mid-sentence — must be caught. Fix should attempt 'The Contractor shall' rewrite but this pattern won't match.

entries.text: Sand & gravel aggregates conform to ASTM C33.

expected.reason: '&' between words — SYM-and pattern \b(\w+)\s*&\s*(\w+)\b matches. Must be caught.

entries.text: The compressive strength is 4000 psi at 28 days, etc.

expected.reason: 'etc.' — TERM-etc matches \betc\.\b pattern. Must be caught.

entries.text: The Contractor and/or subcontractor is responsible for testing.

expected.reason: 'and/or' — TERM-007 must catch. Replace with 'or'.

entries.text: Furnish and install all HVAC equipment in accordance with the drawings.

expected.reason: 'Furnish' (case-insensitive \bfurnish\b) — must be caught. Replace with 'provide'.

entries.text: The concrete should reach design strength before form removal.

expected.reason: 'should' in a non-note block — TERM-002 must catch.

entries.text: Apply waterproofing per manufacturer instructions.

expected.reason: 'per manufacturer' — 'manufacturer' not in exclusion list. Must flag.

entries.text: The test result is 50% of the design capacity.

expected.reason: '50%' — SYM-percent pattern (\d)\s*% matches. Replace with 'percent'.

entries.text: Torque bolts to 150 ft–lbs minimum.

expected.reason: En-dash (\u2013) in 'ft–lbs' — FMT-002 catches [\u2013\u2014]. Replace with hyphen.

entries.text: The Contractor must provide all temporary utilities.

expected.reason: 'Contractor must provide' — TERM-003 exact match. Replace with 'Provide'.

entries.text: Install expansion joints as necessary along the building perimeter.

expected.reason: 'as necessary' — TERM-017 exact match.

entries.text: Fasten all components securely to the structural frame.

expected.reason: 'securely' — TERM-023 vague term. Must flag.

entries.text: Clean all surfaces thoroughly before applying primer.

expected.reason: 'thoroughly' — TERM-024 vague term. Must flag.

entries.text: Select a finish suitable for exterior exposure.

expected.reason: 'suitable' — TERM-suitable vague term. Must flag.

entries.text: The temperature is 90°F at time of placement.

expected.reason: '90°' — SYM-005 pattern (\d)\s*° matches. Replace with 'degrees'.

entries.text: Provide #4 rebar at 300 mm spacing.

expected.reason: '#4' — SYM-pound pattern matches # adjacent to digits. Replace with 'number'.

entries.text: Use per cent as the unit for all mix proportions.

expected.reason: 'per cent' — both FMT-004 and TERM-per exclusion (per cent) apply. FMT-004 catches it. TERM-per should NOT also flag.

entries.text: “Type A” adhesive conforming to ASTM standards.

expected.reason: Smart quotes \u201C and \u201D — FMT-003 catches. Replace with straight quotes.

entries.text: Government-furnished equipment is delivered to the site by others.

expected.reason: 'Government' IS capitalized correctly — CAP-Government only matches lowercase 'government'. This should NOT flag.

entries.text: Contractor-provided materials conform to the specifications.

expected.reason: 'Contractor' IS capitalized correctly — CAP-Contractor only matches lowercase 'contractor'. Should NOT flag.

entries.text: The general contractor coordinates with all subcontractors.

expected.reason: lowercase 'contractor' in 'general contractor' — CAP-Contractor regex (?<![A-Za-z])contractor(?![A-Za-z]) matches because space precedes 'contractor'. Real FP: 'general contractor' is a common noun phrase.

entries.text: The concrete deck surface is finished to a tolerance of 3 mm in 3 m.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-deck now excludes 'concrete deck' — before-text check catches 'concrete' preceding 'deck'.

entries.text: The bridge deck overlay is applied after surface preparation.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-deck exclusion checks 10 chars before match for 'bridge'. 'bridge ' precedes 'deck' — should NOT flag.

entries.text: Install deck plate covers over all floor openings.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-deck exclusion checks 10 chars after match for 'plate|drain|coating|slab'. 'plate' follows 'deck' — should NOT flag.

entries.text: The roof deck system provides a minimum R-30 insulation value.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-deck now excludes 'roof deck' — before-text check catches 'roof' preceding 'deck'.

entries.text: Suitable for the intended application as defined in ASTM D4263.

expected.reason: 'suitable' — TERM-suitable has no context exclusion. Even with a specific ASTM reference making it arguably precise, the engine flags the word itself.

entries.text: Properly aligned as verified by transit survey to within 3 mm tolerance.

expected.reason: 'properly' — TERM-adequate/VAGUE matches. Even though specific verification method and tolerance are stated, 'properly' itself triggers the rule.

entries.text: The applicable codes and standards listed in Section 01 42 00 govern.

expected.reason: 'applicable' — VAGUE-applicable matches. Common in specs but technically vague per UFS. Real FP found 3x in clean corpus.

entries.text: Coordinate with other trades as necessary to avoid conflicts.

expected.reason: 'as necessary' — TERM-017 exact match. Technically a violation even though it's a standard coordination clause.

entries.text: Handle materials carefully to prevent damage to finishes.

expected.reason: 'carefully' — TERM-029 matches. Real FP found in clean corpus.

entries.text: The system is to be tested before final acceptance.

expected.reason: 'is to be' — TERM-to-be pattern matches. Real finding from clean corpus.

entries.text: All connections are to be welded in accordance with AWS D1.1.

expected.reason: 'are to be' — TERM-to-be pattern matches. Common construction spec phrasing.

entries.text: As approved by the Contracting Officer, alternative materials may be substituted.

expected.reason: 'as approved by the Contracting Officer' — TERM-019 exact match. Real FP from clean corpus.

entries.text: Materials conforming to ASTM C33 are acceptable.

expected.reason: 'conforming to' — TERM-032 redundant wording. Engine flags despite being standard specs language.

entries.text: As directed by the Contracting Officer, modify the work schedule.

expected.reason: 'as directed by the Contracting Officer' — TERM-020 exact match. Real FP from clean corpus.

entries.text: Use an approved type of waterproofing membrane.

expected.reason: 'an approved type' — TERM-018 exact match. Real FP from clean corpus.

entries.text: Provide dead head anchors at each end of the tensioning strand.

expected.reason: 'head' in 'dead head' — COLLOQ-head has no exclusion for this post-tensioning term. Will flag.

entries.text: Maintain minimum static head of 3 meters at the pump suction.

expected.reason: 'head' in 'static head' — standard hydraulics term but COLLOQ-head has no exclusion. Will flag.

entries.text: The fire sprinkler head spacing conforms to NFPA 13.

expected.reason: 'head' in 'sprinkler head' — standard fire protection term but no COLLOQ-head exclusion. Will flag.

entries.text: Measure the velocity head and total dynamic head at the pump discharge.

expected.reason: Two 'head' occurrences — 'velocity head' and 'dynamic head'. COLLOQ-head flags both. Standard hydraulic engineering terms.

entries.text: The overhead clearance is 2400 mm.

expected.reason: 'overhead' — \bhead\b won't match inside 'overhead' because there's no word boundary between 'over' and 'head'.

entries.text: Furnish and install equipment in accordance with manufacturer instructions.

expected.reason: 'Furnish' — TERM-furnish matches. UFS says use 'provide'. This is the most debated rule because 'furnish and install' is extremely common.

entries.text: The moisture content is 12 percent, tested per ASTM D4442.

expected.reason: 'per ASTM' — not in exclusion list. UFS requires 'in accordance with' even before standard references.

entries.text: The bearing capacity is 3000 pounds per square foot.

expected.reason: 'per square' — the exclusion now covers 'square' in addition to 'sq'. Valid unit expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: Apply 2 coats per coat manufacturer recommended thickness.

expected.reason: 'per coat' — 'coat' not in exclusion list. But this is ambiguous: does 'per' mean 'according to' or 'for each'? UFS says replace regardless.

entries.text: Install bollards at 1500 mm on center.

expected.reason: No 'per' in this text. Control entry — should produce zero TERM-per violations.

entries.text: Design wind load is 100 pounds per square foot at 50-year return interval.

expected.reason: 'per square' — the exclusion now covers 'square'. Valid engineering unit expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: Concrete shall achieve a minimum compressive strength of [27.6 MPa] [4000 psi].

expected.reason: 'shall' OUTSIDE brackets — must flag. The bracketed values should be excluded by bracket exclusion but 'shall' is before the brackets.

entries.text: Provide [suitable] material for backfill.

expected.reason: 'suitable' is INSIDE brackets — bracket exclusion should skip it.

entries.text: Use aggregate [per ASTM C33] for concrete mix.

expected.reason: 'per' is INSIDE brackets — bracket exclusion should skip it.

entries.text: Provide any fittings [as necessary] for the installation.

expected.reason: 'any fittings' — 'any' is OUTSIDE brackets and 'fittings' doesn't match exclusions. Will flag. '[as necessary]' is inside brackets and should NOT flag for TERM-017.

entries.text: The Officer in Charge of Construction approves all submittals.

expected.reason: 'Officer in Charge of Construction' — TERM-010 exact match. Replace with 'Contracting Officer'. Real FP from clean corpus.

entries.text: The Contracting Officer Representative reviews the test results.

expected.reason: 'Contracting Officer Representative' — TERM-011 exact match. Replace with 'Contracting Officer'.

entries.text: The per diem rate for inspectors is established by the Contracting Officer.

expected.reason: 'per diem' is in the exclusion list — should NOT flag.

entries.text: The head of the pile is trimmed to the specified elevation.

expected.reason: 'head' in 'head of the pile' — standard geotechnical term (pile head) but COLLOQ-head has no exclusion. Will flag.

entries.text: The contract price includes all labor, materials, and equipment.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract price' — compound noun phrase is legitimate lowercase usage.

entries.text: Review the contract documents before commencing work.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract documents' — legitimate compound noun phrase.

entries.text: The total contract amount does not include change orders.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract amount' — legitimate compound noun phrase.

entries.text: Submit the subcontract work schedule for approval.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract exclusion: 'sub' precedes 'contract' in 'subcontract work'.

entries.text: The contract period is 365 calendar days from the notice to proceed.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract period' — after-text check catches 'period'.

entries.text: Notify the Contracting Officer upon contract award.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract award' — after-text check catches 'award'.

entries.text: The contract administration office reviews all submittals.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract administration' — after-text check catches 'administration'.

entries.text: All contract drawings are incorporated by reference.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract drawing(s)' — after-text check catches 'drawing'.

entries.text: Each contract item is listed in the schedule of prices.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract item' — after-text check catches 'item'.

entries.text: Include the contract plans in the submittal package.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract plan(s)' — after-text check catches 'plan'.

entries.text: The contract completion date is established by the notice to proceed.

expected.reason: CAP-Contract now excludes 'contract completion' — after-text check catches 'completion'.

entries.text: Ensure the contract is executed before mobilizing to the site.

expected.reason: Bare 'contract' followed by 'is' — not in the compound-noun exclusion list. Engine flags lowercase 'contract'.

entries.text: The contract requires a performance bond equal to 100 percent of the contract sum.

expected.reason: Two 'contract' occurrences: 'contract requires' — 'requires' not in exclusion list, so first one flags. 'contract sum' — 'sum' IS in exclusion list, so second one should NOT flag.

entries.text: Reference the contract for applicable liquidated damages provisions.

expected.reason: 'contract for' — 'for' is not in the exclusion list. Engine flags bare lowercase 'contract'.

entries.text: If the contract is modified, resubmit all affected shop drawings.

expected.reason: 'contract is' — 'is' is not in the compound-noun exclusion. Refers to THE Contract; should be capitalized.

entries.text: The contract states that all work is warranted for one year.

expected.reason: 'contract states' — 'states' not in exclusion list. Refers to THE Contract; should be capitalized.

entries.text: Under the contract, the Contractor provides all materials.

expected.reason: 'the contract,' — no following compound noun. Refers to THE Contract; should be capitalized.

entries.text: Amend the contract to reflect the revised scope of work.

expected.reason: 'the contract to' — 'to' is not in the exclusion list. Refers to THE Contract; should be capitalized.

entries.text: Obligations under this contract are binding on all parties.

expected.reason: 'this contract are' — 'are' not in exclusion list. Refers to THE Contract; should be capitalized.

entries.text: No changes to the contract may be made without written authorization.

expected.reason: 'the contract may' — 'may' not in the exclusion list. Refers to THE Contract; should be capitalized.

entries.text: This contract supersedes all prior agreements.

expected.reason: 'contract supersedes' — not in the exclusion list. Refers to THE Contract; should be capitalized.

entries.text: Provide 100 square feet per sack of cement for coverage calculations.

expected.reason: 'per sack' — 'sack' is now in the exclusion list. Valid rate expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: Apply primer at 200 square feet per kit.

expected.reason: 'per kit' — 'kit' is now in the exclusion list. Valid rate expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: The flow rate is 3 gallons per minute at 40 psi.

expected.reason: 'per minute' — 'min' is in exclusion and 'minute' matches via 'min' prefix. Should NOT flag.

entries.text: Provide per 100 square feet of floor area as scheduled.

expected.reason: 'per 100' — 'per + digit' is in the exclusion list (\d lookahead). Should NOT flag.

entries.text: Install one luminaire per 50 square feet of floor area.

expected.reason: 'per 50' — 'per + digit' exclusion. Should NOT flag.

entries.text: The bearing capacity is 2000 pounds per linear foot.

expected.reason: 'per linear' — 'linear' is in the exclusion list. Valid engineering unit should NOT flag.

entries.text: Test each interval per the inspection schedule.

expected.reason: 'per the' is NOT in the exclusion list — but wait, 'the' is not a unit. This is 'per' meaning 'in accordance with'. Let me check: the exclusion is a lookahead, 'the' is not in it. This WILL flag.

entries.text: Mix ratios are established per industry practice.

expected.reason: 'per industry' — 'industry' is not in the exclusion list. 'per' means 'in accordance with'. Must flag.

entries.text: Compact backfill per the geotechnical report recommendations.

expected.reason: 'per the geotechnical' — 'the' is not in exclusion. 'per' means 'in accordance with'. Must flag.

entries.text: Cure concrete per ACI 308 guidelines.

expected.reason: 'per ACI' — standard org name not in exclusion. 'per' means 'in accordance with'. Must flag.

entries.text: Install fasteners per the engineer of record requirements.

expected.reason: 'per the engineer' — 'the' is not in the exclusion list. 'per' = 'in accordance with'. Must flag.

entries.text: Maintain one fire extinguisher per interval along the corridor.

expected.reason: 'per interval' — 'interval' is now in the exclusion list. Valid rate expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: Provide ventilation at 20 CFM per person in occupied zones.

expected.reason: 'per person' — 'person' is now in exclusion. Valid rate expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: Allocate 2 receptacles per unit in each dwelling.

expected.reason: 'per unit' — 'unit' is now in exclusion. Valid rate expression should NOT flag.

entries.text: The ceiling is suspended from the structural slab above.

expected.reason: 'is suspended' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'suspended' describes a physical state (suspended ceiling is standard construction terminology).

entries.text: The beam is cantilevered 3 meters beyond the column line.

expected.reason: 'is cantilevered' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'cantilevered' describes a structural configuration.

entries.text: The coating is anodized to a minimum thickness of 25 microns.

expected.reason: 'is anodized' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'anodized' describes a surface treatment state.

entries.text: The cable is rated for 600 volts.

expected.reason: 'is rated' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'rated' describes a specification state.

entries.text: The panel is listed by UL for the intended application.

expected.reason: 'is listed' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'listed' describes a certification state.

entries.text: The surface is sealed with a penetrating sealer.

expected.reason: 'is sealed' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'sealed' describes a treatment state.

entries.text: The equipment is enclosed in a weatherproof housing.

expected.reason: 'is enclosed' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'enclosed' describes a physical configuration.

entries.text: Each conductor is labeled at both ends.

expected.reason: 'is labeled' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'labeled' describes an identification state.

entries.text: The rebar is coupled using mechanical splices at lap locations.

expected.reason: 'is coupled' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'coupled' describes a connection state.

entries.text: The joint is grouted with non-shrink cementitious grout.

expected.reason: 'is grouted' — now excluded by ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES set. 'grouted' describes a fill state.

entries.text: The test is performed weekly by a certified technician.

expected.reason: 'is performed' — passive voice with agent ('by a certified technician'). 'performed' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Must flag.

entries.text: The work is supervised by a licensed professional engineer.

expected.reason: 'is supervised' — passive voice with agent. 'supervised' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Must flag.

entries.text: All samples are reviewed and approved by the Contracting Officer.

expected.reason: 'are reviewed' — passive voice with agent ('by the Contracting Officer'). 'reviewed' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Must flag.

entries.text: The excavation is monitored continuously during dewatering operations.

expected.reason: 'is monitored' — passive voice. 'monitored' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Must flag.

entries.text: Load tests are conducted at each pile location.

expected.reason: 'are conducted' — passive voice. 'conducted' is NOT in ENGINEERING_ADJECTIVES. Must flag.

entries.text: Install the concrete deck slab in accordance with the structural drawings.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-deck now excludes 'concrete deck' — before-text check catches 'concrete' preceding 'deck'.

entries.text: The roof deck is galvanized steel, 22 gauge minimum.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-deck now excludes 'roof deck' — before-text check catches 'roof' preceding 'deck'.

entries.text: Provide steel deck with composite concrete fill.

expected.reason: COLLOQ-deck now excludes 'steel deck' — before-text check catches 'steel' preceding 'deck'.

entries.text: The observation deck provides an unobstructed view of the facility.

expected.reason: 'observation deck' — 'observation' is NOT in the before-text exclusion (bridge|concrete|roof|steel). Colloquial use of 'deck' for a platform. Must flag.

entries.text: Level the deck surface to a tolerance of 3 mm per 3 meters.

expected.reason: Bare 'deck' with no recognized qualifier before or after. Not a technical compound noun — engine flags it.

entries.text: Specify model # for all major equipment items.

expected.reason: 'model #' — SYM-pound now catches bare '#' in contexts like 'model #' and 'item #'. Replace with 'number'.
